programme.title: 野性汪洋 #5
programme.desc: 印度尼西亚群岛位于珊瑚三角区的中心地带,那是世界公认的海洋生物多样性中心。印尼拥有地球上最丰富的珊瑚礁,亦有著最多珊瑚和鱼类的品种,但这些珊瑚礁正受到威胁

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #1
programme.desc: 一群勇敢的雄性企鹅聚集在水边,准备在岸上进行危险的旅程。面对前路的险途,数量多比较安全。这些小企鹅有著重要的任务,繁殖的时候到了,牠们必须在雌性到来前找到一个洞穴。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #2
programme.desc: 纽西兰的西岸不像世上任何地方。从冰川覆盖的山脉到原始雨林,再到严酷的寒冷海域,壮丽景致令人难以置信。这片与世隔绝几乎未被触及的桃花园,隐藏著许多土生的动物。进化的漂流者,每一个都是罕见的生态瑰宝。从啄羊鹦鹉和害羞的企鹅到哺乳类般的鹬鸵和古老的鳗鱼,为了于这种条件下生存,这里的野生动物必须坚强,狡猾和足智多谋。沿著西岸的旅程让你窥见这片美地,以及生活在这里的野生动物的考验和磨难。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #5
programme.desc: 纽西兰与世隔绝的岛屿是不凡的天堂及家园,以拥有多元又独特的野生动物闻名。尤以不会飞的鸟类、古代爬行类和沿海哺乳类最为人所共知,仔细观察将会发现另一个世界。这里有微型的怪物、小型的掠夺者和微小的恐怖,却带来了非凡的生命。每个猎人也是猎物﹐永远需要努力生存。走进灌木丛,又会发现不同规模的生活。从巨型肉食蜈蚣和夜行蟋蟀到捕鱼蛛和使用丝质陷阱的发光蠕虫。奇怪而奇妙,这些无名英雄是野性纽西兰最令人毛骨悚然的爬行类。

programme.title: 树熊异闻录 #1
programme.desc: 尽管树熊是澳洲最著名的动物,但牠们仅在国内东部和东南部地区被发现。虽然牠们生活在广泛的森林中,从干旱到热带到温带都可以,但牠们的群体经常被不宜的栖息地所隔离。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6
programme.desc: 在尚比亚西部生活著一个家庭: 一个斑鬣狗家族。这族群中,较大的雌性作主,较小的雄性过著投闲置散的生活。族中的女王有幼崽,各有自己的保姆,一头孤儿发觉自己处于社会底层。

programme.title: 深入印度 #1
programme.desc: 白眉长臂猿是印度丛林的专家。生活在亲密的家庭中,少猴花费数年时间学习生存的技能。为你介绍沙马,牠寻找食物,避开掠食者,并掌握于林木间生活所需的杂技。

programme.title: 深入印度 #2
programme.desc: 印度东北部的草原是地球上最肥沃的栖息地之一,该处生长茂盛的野草,让罕见的印度犀牛赖以维生,并茁壮成长。

programme.title: 深入印度 #3
programme.desc: 拉达克高原是一片极端之地,但西藏野驴是这片草原的王者。跟随一匹影响一群雌性的种马,她有机会繁殖下一代,但若然如此,她必须与那些想要牠皇冠的对手作战!

programme.title: 深入印度 #4
programme.desc: 在灼热和充满热带风暴的土地上,印度南部平原的生活十分艰苦。但一头带著两只幼崽的雌性树懒比比,正迎接她生活上的挑战,她每刻都要对抗缺水缺粮和掠食者。

programme.title: 潜鸟: 迷雾中的呐喊
programme.desc: 与生物学家们一起争分夺秒,试图找出北美潜鸟突然濒临灭绝的原因。揭开这些受人喜爱的鸟类的神秘面纱,想想是让牠们的叫声继续成为夏天的配乐还是永远沉寂下去。

programme.title: 鱼鹰: 海洋迅猛禽
programme.desc: 一对老鱼鹰回到康州盐沼的家中。牠们在整个夏天必须与敌人作战,忍耐恶劣天气,捕猎千百条鱼,只为养育下一代。

programme.title: 潮游国度
programme.desc: 退潮时露出一条称为潮间带的海岸。这是一个令人惊愕的极端之地,受到热带气旋 风浪的冲击,又暴露在酷热中。这里的生物以无数怪异的方式进化。 科学家们探索这个外星之境。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战
programme.desc: 见证大白鲨群英的终极战斗!科学家们尝试从新西兰海岸外的100多条大白鲨中,挑选出领头的鲨王。一起为群雄的速度、猎食技能和无比勇气而喝采。

programme.title: 深入内地
programme.desc: 透过马修・麦康纳的旁述,跟随鲶鱼、虎猫等当地生物的视角,展开一场奇妙之旅。让我们一同赞颂德克萨斯州的地景风貌和野生动物,并深入了解保育工作对拯救德克萨斯州独特栖息地的重要性。

programme.title: 野火劫后 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近发生灾难性森林大火的后续,透过充满希望、人为干预和复原力的故事,记录野生动植物的长期恢复情况。本节目发放了一个十万火急的讯息,不要太迟爱护大自然。

programme.title: 野生动物如何睡觉
programme.desc: 动物之间的睡眠策略千变万化,然而睡眠似乎是一种再普遍不过的行为。但究竟为何动物需要睡眠呢?它们如何应对无法休息或在野外昏迷可能带来的危险?这些问题只是《野生动物如何睡觉》中的冰山一角。

programme.desc: 与生物学家们一起争分夺秒,试图找出北美潜鸟突然濒临灭绝的原因。揭开这些受人喜爱的鸟类的神秘面纱,想想是让牠们的叫声继续成为夏天的配乐还是永远沉寂下去。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #1
programme.desc: 马达加斯加是地球上任何其他地方都找不到的奇怪动物的家。当这些动物为权位而战,牠们的战斗也很奇特——从象鼻虫怪异的脖子摔角,到环尾狐猴母婴间的打斗。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #6
programme.desc: 在布满垃圾的海床下,一群奇特而迷人的生物在逆境中茁壮成长。在这个肮脏的生态系统中,捕食者和猎物展开演化过程中的军备竞赛,并发展出超乎想像的攻击和防御技术。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #1
programme.desc: 雅拉国家公园的森林是神秘懒熊的家。这种动物生性害羞,很少被看见及拍摄。加入野生动物影片制作团队,跟著他们揭开前所未见的神秘懒熊生活和行为。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #2
programme.desc: 大象中途之家 (Elephant Transit Home) 来了新成员: 一只生病的小象在自然保护区附近被抛弃,这是人类和大象争夺空间下的又一个受害者。深入了解在普鲁图·费南多博士的领导下,如何以创新的方式努力结束这场冲突。

programme.title: 野战攻略 #3
programme.desc: 兰卡猕猴隐藏在斯里兰卡的森林中。作为岛上的土生动物,这群活泼的群居猴子在世上独一无二。牠们是有史以来最长的灵长类动物研究项目的核心。胡夫间铁达时博士致力了解牠们复杂的社会。

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #3
programme.desc: 这是「黄金森林」的故事,坐落在非洲西南海岸的大片海带。由大西洋深处的营养物质所养育,滋润著四个不同的世界。

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #4
programme.desc: 位处非洲南部海岸的阿尔哥亚湾,是该大陆唯一的企鹅避难所。跟企鹅一起求生,牠们勇于接受难以容忍的因素,以建立一个不可能的海洋社区。

programme.title: 树熊异闻录 #2
programme.desc: 树熊看起来是经常静止不动和独居的,但交配季节标志著牠们行为上戏剧性的转变,代表著更多走动、接触和冲突。随著维多利亚州奥特威海角的繁殖季节开始,我们跟随正在准备交配的大型雄性洛奇和毕士打。对雌性来说,这可能是一个紧张时期,尤其是去年仍然年轻的小树熊。

programme.title: 灵长大地 #8
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亚海岸青翠的桑给巴尔岛上,生活著一家红疣猴。牠们是同类中仅存的一伙,被困在一个萎缩的天堂里。在人口不断增长的压力下,他们称牠们为「毒猴」,而且森林被外来物种入侵。如果小叶猴要适应牠的新世界,将需要新技巧和父母的知识。

programme.title: 「虫」林的法则 #1
programme.desc: 一旦天气变冷变黑,昆虫开始从草地和田地消失,牠们会慢慢消失直至全灭。所有动物都有其特殊的生存方式,像燕子和鹤这种候鸟会飞向南方,许多像鹿一样的哺乳动物会得到厚厚的冬季皮毛或躲在温暖的地方冬眠。但昆虫都做了甚么?为何牠们在春天就会回归?

programme.title: 「虫」林的法则 #2
programme.desc: 太恐怖了!这是谋杀!残酷的死亡以及刺激的战斗,还有特殊的绝地救援。你在看到它之后就会知道最令人毛骨悚然的地方其实就是你附近的草丛。利用来自恐怖类型的型格设备,这部非凡的自然纪录片将带您跟随一位著名英雄,牠有六条腿、红色的翅膀和七个黑点,这趟旅程的目的地是一个看似正常但充满怪物的草丛。

programme.title: 「虫」林的法则 #3
programme.desc: 甲虫已经在地球上居住了超过24亿年。科学家们已知的甲虫大约有38万种,而每年都会发现数百种新品种。世上四分之一的动物是甲虫。牠们几乎征服了地球上每个角落和栖息地,在每次全球灾难中都能幸存下来。牠们为何如此成功?

programme.title: 饥饿游戏: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑战 #1
programme.desc: 七只饥肠辘辘的大熊刚从冬眠中苏醒过来,挑战随即展开!一起见证新手妈妈如何与狼群作战,身型细小的跺跺如何争夺地盘和金松少女的爱,并旁观老练的伯尼如何与出其不己的少年卡萨诺瓦搏斗。

programme.title: 喀尔巴阡猎手 #1 英普
programme.desc: 喀尔巴阡山脉横跨七个欧洲国家;它有著广阔的原始森林、陡峭的峡谷和孤立的山峰,为这片大陆最具魅力的生物提供了宝贵的避难所。

programme.title: 喀尔巴阡猎手 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在欧洲,喀尔巴阡山脉的偏远荒野是由古老森林和陡峭峡谷组成的一片戏剧性土地。神秘生物在这处仍漫步野外,崎岖的景观是一种捕食者的家园,牠在整个历史中刻下敬畏和恐惧: 欧亚狼。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #1
programme.desc: 在马达加斯加偏远的伯伦蒂保育区,两个环尾狐猴派别因正面临旱季日益严峻的挑战而拉起战幔。这些魅力非凡的狐猴仅在马达加斯加岛上被发现,黑白相间的尾巴十分突出,牠们活在女权体制中,每个帮派都有严格的等级制度,并拥有各自严守的领土。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #2
programme.desc: 在马达加斯加偏远的贝伦地���育区,旱季正对当地的环尾狐猴造成巨大的损耗。随著觅食的难度增加,对立帮派领导人姬丝图和嘉缇之间的关系越发紧张。随著食物和水源日益稀缺,入侵者亦出现在附近。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #3
programme.desc: 在长期干旱过后,第一场雨的降临大大地纾缓了马达加斯加贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴帮。森林里的食物十分充足,对立帮派领导人姬丝图和嘉缇率领族群离开领土大快朵颐。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #4
programme.desc: 狐?岛上的帮派奋力保持族群的健康和领土的完整。随著婴儿们成长,牠们的阶级架构开始出现裂缝,权力备受考验。由学习食甚么、交友、结盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?岛上婴儿的生活跟成年狐?一样艰辛。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.title: 喀尔巴阡猎手 #1 英普
programme.desc: 喀尔巴阡山脉横跨七个欧洲国家;它有著广阔的原始森林、陡峭的峡谷和孤立的山峰,为这片大陆最具魅力的生物提供了宝贵的避难所。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #4
programme.desc: 阿弗林在自己的家乡多伦多展开一场迷你环球起司之旅,这座城市是世界上最多元且充满文化魅力的地方之一。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #5
programme.desc: 阿弗林的起司寻味之旅来到希腊——菲达起司的发源地,起司文化可追溯至数千年前的古老传统。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #6
programme.desc: 阿弗林的最后一站是风景如画的加拿大卑诗省西岸,当地创新的起司文化由「支持在地」的精神所驱动。

programme.title: 进化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「后院」,发现美味的素寿司、开心果奶油甜馅煎饼卷和薄饼;他与喜剧演员巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士厂试工。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 下一站: 中国云南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中国云南》将带领观众欣赏云南一些最美、最壮观的风景,那是约6,000种植物、200种哺乳类动物和500种鸟类的家。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #1
programme.desc: 占美前往繁忙的湍溪市场,穿梭在熟食档、农夫和每周采购的当地人之间。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #2
programme.desc: 占美拜访一些正为希腊文化节准备食物的希腊社区;他到访色彩缤纷的马拉克夜市。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #3
programme.desc: 占美解释为何北领地顶端地带拥有全国最好、最新鲜的海鲜;他在达尔文码头遇到自学成才的厨师瑞秋西索卡,并学习如何烹制她的招牌菜- 柠檬柚子泥蟹。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #4
programme.desc: 占美前往偏远的曼宁立达的阿纳姆地沿海社区,在丛林中品尝美食。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #5
programme.desc: 占美在帕华普周末市集的档摊品尝达尔文的流行街头小食;并讨论达尔文对叻沙的迷恋。

programme.title: 北领地好味道 #6
programme.desc: 占美跟卡卡杜的风景打卡;他与原住民梅曼迪聊天,他带著占美沿著黄水河游船河饱览她的国家。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #6
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣加入世上最极端、最容易发生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鸟的团队。他们使用铲子、压雪车,甚至二战的榴弹砲,奋力保卫陡峭斜坡的安全。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #7
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣前往世上最大的自动化包裹分类设施 - 位于肯塔基州路易维尔的联合包裹服务公司世界港。每天有200万个包裹途经这里,全靠幕后一班戴著安全帽的英雄实现这一切。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #8
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣在费城的街道、隧道、轨道和电车修车库中与团队并肩合作,使美国最大、最古老的大众交通系统之一畅顺并准时运作。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #2
programme.desc: 每十分钟就有一辆新卡车从生产线出货,配备了度身订制的生产线,以满足瑞典汽车集团-富豪的个别客户需求。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #3
programme.desc: 在下萨克森的迈尔造船厂,世上第一艘天然气游轮正在建造当中。这艘337米长的船上可容纳多��6,600名乘客、一间电视广播录影厂和一座剧院。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #4
programme.desc: 紧急和特种部队人员的安全车自有其存在目的。警队的特种服务车辆是为冲破路障和其他障碍物而设的。

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #5
programme.desc: 自2017年以来,风力发电已成为德国第二大能源。全国有近 30,000台风力涡轮机在运作,覆盖约19%的能源消耗。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 #3
programme.desc: 从巨型媒体帝国的女继承人到被通缉的重犯,见证1974年的派蒂赫兹绑架奇案。

programme.title: 汤姆汉克斯: 演无不克
programme.desc: 从出身卑微到成为有抱负的演员,再到扮演世上最具标志性和最著名的角色。他赢得了「美国好人」、「平民」和艺术游牧民的美誉。而我们都知道他……是 汤姆汉克斯。

programme.title: 布莱德彼特: 突破好莱坞
programme.desc: 他可能是最性感的荷里活演员之一,但他的职业和个人目标比他的外表更有味道。布莱德彼特。整个荷里活首屈一指的人物之一。一个默默无闻的天才转变为超级巨星的故事。

programme.title: 哈里逊福特: 好莱坞英雄
programme.desc: 每个人都认为自己熟悉夏里逊福。他们认识富有冒险精神的反纳粹考古学家和反乌托邦未来的银翼杀手。但一旦停下摄录机,就没有人真正了解演员的真实人生了。

programme.title: 海猎人 #2

programme.title: 海猎人 #4

programme.title: 海猎人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙热的阳光下,大批海豹群聚于纳米比亚骷髅海岸。雄性海豹体重可达 360 公斤,巡守领域以保护雌性与幼崽。然而,新的陆地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠们学习全新的防御行为。

programme.title: 海猎人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亚瓦尔德斯半岛的中心,鲸鱼经常遭到一种体型娇小却意图凶残的掠食者袭击——海鸥。牠们迫使鲸鱼潜入深海,远离赖以生存的氧气与光线。

programme.desc: 从数千英尺高空探索西开普省迷人的海岸线、注目的山脉和多样性的大都会。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #5
programme.desc: 要观察这片充满地质现象的土地,只能从高空欣赏其雄伟的真面貌。从散布在海岸线上被遗忘的沉船到卡奥科兰无解的仙女圈,纳米比亚的秘密将被揭开。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #6
programme.desc: 在丰富多彩的非洲国家-尚比亚上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和挤满世上最贫穷的人的市场。

programme.title: 空中战士 11 #1
programme.desc: 这部纪录片系列展示五代喷射机。这些战机能够携带炸弹并飞近太空边缘。第六代战机从2020年开始服役,第11季至今已经覆盖了大部分此后的空中兵器。

programme.title: 空中战士 11 #2
programme.desc: 这部纪录片系列展示五代喷射机。这些战机能够携带炸弹并飞近太空边缘。第六代战机从2020年开始服役,第11季至今已经覆盖了大部分此后的空中兵器。

programme.title: 空中战士 11 #3
programme.desc: 这部纪录片系列展示五代喷射机。这些战机能够携带炸弹并飞近太空边缘。第六代战机从2020年开始服役,第11季至今已经覆盖了大部分此后的空中兵器。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #5
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣展开一场跨国公路旅行,以帮助井井有条基金会。他们致力寻找并封锁全美各地估计200万个泄漏、有毒、可能致命的废弃石油和天然气井。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #6
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣加入世上最极端、最容易发生雪崩的滑雪山之一- 雪鸟的团队。他们使用铲子、压雪车,甚至二战的榴弹砲,奋力保卫陡峭斜坡的安全。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #7
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣前往世上最大的自动化包裹分类设施 - 位于肯塔基州路易维尔的联合包裹服务公司世界港。每天有200万个包裹途经这里,全靠幕后一班戴著安全帽的英雄实现这一切。

programme.title: 维修的奥秘 2 #8
programme.desc: 米克大卫臣在费城的街道、隧道、轨道和电车修车库中与团队并肩合作,使美国最大、最古老的大众交通系统之一畅顺并准时运作。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 下一站: 中国云南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中国云南》将带领观众欣赏云南一些最美、最壮观的风景,那是约6,000种植物、200种哺乳类动物和500种鸟类的家。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #5
programme.desc: 这些动物生活在极端环境中,却创造出巧妙的工具和技术来为生存应对最严峻的挑战。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #6
programme.desc: 从出生起就充满了风险和回报。动物为了成年必须不断克服难以置信的障碍。牠们必须学习觅食、保护家园、吸引配偶、养儿育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7
programme.desc: 从在树枝上寻找配偶,到适应高处生活,树栖动物进化出独有的特征,以确保牠们在这恶劣又复杂的环境茁壮成长。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #8
programme.desc: 猎物们利用巧妙的适应力和狡猾的技巧,进化出难以置信的技巧来逃避死亡。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #9
programme.desc: 爬行动物、两栖动物、昆虫和鱼类遍布我们世界的每个角落——而对于这一特殊的动物群体而言,牠们的生活是由太阳所主宰的。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 仅仅是有一点点不同,就可能带来巨大的优势,但同时也会带来极大的挑战。这些动物逆势而行,找到了独特的生存之道。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #5

programme.title: 海猎人 #4

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester shockingly injured Saluki Susie limps onto a petrol station forecourt and into Inspector Becky Goulding's life Susie's found with football socks tied tightly around her legs One fractured leg is damaged beyond repair and has to be removed After Susie's sad start will she find her happy ending?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? programme.desc: 海军犯罪调查局在胁持人质事件中寻找失踪的卧底探员。

programme.desc: 凡斯准备主持与委内瑞拉的外交会谈,小队被委派调查他一名线人的尸体。

programme.title: 环游世界80天
programme.desc: 1872年,一位英国发明家、一位中国小偷和一位法国艺术家出发,用80天完成环球航行。他们通过海陆空和滚轴溜冰,争分夺秒回到起点。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #1
programme.desc: 一名 71 岁男子被发现倒卧田间中弹身亡,调查人员一开始怀疑是抢劫杀人。然而随著新证据浮现,侦探们提出一个离奇的理论来解释他的死因,而唯有受害者「来自坟墓的声音」能证实真相。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #2
programme.desc: 一名女子在底特律饭店猝然身亡,随之揭开的是一张充满秘密、谎言与致命巧合的黑暗之网——所有迹象都暗示著一股更加邪恶的力量。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #3
programme.desc: 一名海军军官在海上待了数月后因神秘病症死亡,毫无线索,直到验尸揭露惊人真相。所有调查线索都走入死胡同——直到他们锁定了一个最不可能的嫌疑人。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #4
programme.desc: 一名忠诚的丈夫、军人、三个孩子的父亲,亲自打电话向警方做出毛骨悚然的自白: 他射杀了自己的妻子。原本看似单纯的凶杀案,很快就演变成更加复杂的真相。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #5
programme.desc: 当黛安娜巴罗被发现失去意识时,家属与警方起初认为她死于自然原因,直到小镇流言揭露,邻里中的罪犯可能隐藏著致命秘密。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #6
programme.desc: 看似毫不相关的两起事件——卡车火灾与失踪人口通报——最终在一宗致命的身分错认案件中交会。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #7
programme.desc: 一名富有寡妇的猝死让调查人员困惑不已。随著死因相互矛盾,加上牵涉数百万财产,嫌疑逐渐指向她最亲近的人。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #8
programme.desc: 一名马厩看护表面上的自杀事件,在多年后因出现几乎一模一样的犯罪现场而遭到质疑,暗示可能有连环杀手在活动。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #9
programme.desc: 一名休班警察拨打 911 报案,称妻子昏迷不醒。随著疑点逐渐浮现,所有怀疑都指向他可能涉案,但一个出乎意料的转折,彻底改变了一切。

programme.title: 非自然死亡 6 #10
programme.desc: 一名 10 岁男孩拨打 911,坦承自己开枪射中了父亲。看似一场悲剧性的意外,直到九年后,他揭露了一个更黑暗的真相。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #10
programme.desc: 莉莉的哥哥「扎维」突然出现在阿久津和莉莉面前。阿久津被他那绅士风度般的态度当中所隐含的某种令人生畏的气息给震撼,莉莉则是丢下他和扎维一同离去。阿久津很在意莉莉离去时那不自然的笑容,当他追上他们两人时,他看到因为被扎维拿刀指著而吓得浑身发抖的莉莉。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因为被扎维给打伤而哭泣。目睹了这一幕的阿久津,其愤怒达到了巅峰,因而觉醒了恶魔之力。他以压倒性的力量击倒扎维,就在他准备给予其致命一击的瞬间,莉莉挡在了他的面前。然而,阿久津却因为愤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻击莉莉……!?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #3
programme.desc: 多亏适应性高到夸张的同班同学们,虽然身分曝光,妮可和守仁仍能过著一如往常的生活。某日,妮可和守仁收到了妮可的母亲伊吹寄来的行李和信,信中提到了妮可有关的新预言,表示「狗和雨滴会带来灾难」。守仁虽然感到困惑,还是针对这些事处处留心……

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #4
programme.desc: 乌鸦的使魔风祭监志为了守护妮可出现在妮可及守仁面前。监志是天狗,居住在妮可进行魔法修行的山中。他和守仁一样在伊吹的拜托下担任妮可的护卫。但监志却单方面敌视身为鬼的守仁。妮可和守仁的同居生活,现在又有监志这个新人物加入了?

programme.desc: 跟白鸟泽之战开打,一开始牛岛就不断的进攻,连得了好几分。面对左撇子主攻手,西谷表示只要给他三球,他就可以接下来,但即使如此第一局还是被白鸟泽拿下。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 莱利娜为了圣火仪式被赋予了严苛任务,疲惫不已的她来到泉水边,也因此救起了一只溺水的鸟。但刚好在场的大神官希卡认为去救注定要死的鸟只是白费功夫,两人因此起了口角。希卡事后遍寻整个神殿,却怎么都找不到那个对自己失礼,但又令人在意不已的莱利娜。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #10
programme.desc: 希卡看中莱利娜的才能,为了收她为徒而拚尽全力。他不仅打开了那道鲜少开启,通往神圣国的大门,召唤出圣骑士团,以展现大神官的威严,甚至还为了表现亲和力,而说出可以叫他「爷爷」的这种话。就在此时,莱利娜配戴的珠宝发饰发出了诡异的光芒。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #11
programme.desc: 女仆告诫莱利娜千万不能去看位于西馆深处的镜子。因为有传闻说若和镜中魂四目交接,它就会告诉来者任何事情。但莱利娜想知道小说女主角贝儿托利丝的所在,仍在夜晚拿起了镜子。当奇怪的声音吓得莱利娜缩起身体时,出现在她面前的竟不是镜中魂,而是努尔。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #12
programme.desc: 努尔拜访了现今国王,也是他的异母哥哥希亚托里希。当他终于开口提到自己与莱利娜所缔结之契约,希亚托里希当面指出,现在议会会期即将结束,应该已不再需要这个婚约的事实。与此同时,莱利娜前往温奈特家墓地,贝儿托利丝是否会如同小说所描写的一样出现呢?

programme.title: 海贼王 #22
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因为被扎维给打伤而哭泣。目睹了这一幕的阿久津,其愤怒达到了巅峰,因而觉醒了恶魔之力。他以压倒性的力量击倒扎维,就在他准备给予其致命一击的瞬间,莉莉挡在了他的面前。然而,阿久津却因为愤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻击莉莉……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #12
programme.desc: 阿久津在自己的公寓与莉莉亚交谈。莉莉亚讲述了莉莉的出身以及她拼命建立起来的地位,并与破坏这一切阿久津展开对峙……同时,莉莉在阿久津的床上醒来后,误以为自己在睡觉时被他给○○了,于是便挥刀砍向阿久津。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #4
programme.desc: 茜参加了在FOS联名咖啡厅举办的公会线下聚会。虽然她认出山田与疑似是琉璃姬的两人,但对于现场出现的两位男性──瑛太与鸭田却完全没印象。在自我介绍时,鸭田自称是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓农夫。而另一位瑛太则是茜万万没想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #5
programme.desc: 茜虽然想和公会成员们打好关系,但她隐约察觉到瑛太的妹妹琉奈有所保留的态度。琉奈主动邀她去咖啡厅,让茜一度心情大好。但这其实是琉奈的恶作剧,在现场等著的是自称琉璃姬狂热粉丝的陌生男子。而到佐佐木家担任家教的山田察觉到琉奈的神情异常。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #6
programme.desc: 由琉奈的恶作剧引发的骚动,在山田和其他公会成员的调停下顺利落幕,茜也接受了琉奈的道歉。后来茜因与琉奈关系改善,对FOS的热情也愈加高涨,终于和山田在游戏中正式成为好友。然而,因为她长时间沉迷网游,让电脑过度负荷,某天茜的电脑突然爆炸了。

programme.desc: 小透发现草摩家有些人会变身成十二生肖的动物,她答应会保守这个秘密。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #4
programme.desc: 茜参加了在FOS联名咖啡厅举办的公会线下聚会。虽然她认出山田与疑似是琉璃姬的两人,但对于现场出现的两位男性──瑛太与鸭田却完全没印象。在自我介绍时,鸭田自称是在FOS中名叫takezo的草莓农夫。而另一位瑛太则是茜万万没想到的某位玩家。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #5
programme.desc: 茜虽然想和公会成员们打好关系,但她隐约察觉到瑛太的妹妹琉奈有所保留的态度。琉奈主动邀她去咖啡厅,让茜一度心情大好。但这其实是琉奈的恶作剧,在现场等著的是自称琉璃姬狂热粉丝的陌生男子。而到佐佐木家担任家教的山田察觉到琉奈的神情异常。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #6
programme.desc: 由琉奈的恶作剧引发的骚动,在山田和其他公会成员的调停下顺利落幕,茜也接受了琉奈的道歉。后来茜因与琉奈关系改善,对FOS的热情也愈加高涨,终于和山田在游戏中正式成为好友。然而,因为她长时间沉迷网游,让电脑过度负荷,某天茜的电脑突然爆炸了。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #3
programme.desc: 多亏适应性高到夸张的同班同学们,虽然身分曝光,妮可和守仁仍能过著一如往常的生活。某日,妮可和守仁收到了妮可的母亲伊吹寄来的行李和信,信中提到了妮可有关的新预言,表示「狗和雨滴会带来灾难」。守仁虽然感到困惑,还是针对这些事处处留心……

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #4
programme.desc: 乌鸦的使魔风祭监志为了守护妮可出现在妮可及守仁面前。监志是天狗,居住在妮可进行魔法修行的山中。他和守仁一样在伊吹的拜托下担任妮可的护卫。但监志却单方面敌视身为鬼的守仁。妮可和守仁的同居生活,现在又有监志这个新人物加入了?

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #5
programme.desc: 妮可和守仁的班导师真桑老师是个隐性漫画宅。她特别喜欢一部叫「混乱的海市蜃楼」,通称「混乱蜃楼」的作品。某天,她听说自己的学生久久在社群网站上传「混乱蜃楼」的插图,似乎有一万名跟随者,甚至还有一些爆红的插图。于是非常在意的真桑老师……

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #6
programme.desc: 越来越有女人缘的守仁使妮可感到焦虑。明明连监志都查觉到了妮可的心意,但守仁这个当事人完全没注意到。某天,妮可得知学校远足要去的不达山有一棵以能结缘著称的树。传说男女约在树下见面、一起吃过午餐后就能成为情侣。于是监志便要妮可去向守仁告白。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #11
programme.desc: 莉莉因为被扎维给打伤而哭泣。目睹了这一幕的阿久津,其愤怒达到了巅峰,因而觉醒了恶魔之力。他以压倒性的力量击倒扎维,就在他准备给予其致命一击的瞬间,莉莉挡在了他的面前。然而,阿久津却因为愤怒而失去了理智,甚至想要攻击莉莉……!?

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #12
programme.desc: 阿久津在自己的公寓与莉莉亚交谈。莉莉亚讲述了莉莉的出身以及她拼命建立起来的地位,并与破坏这一切阿久津展开对峙……同时,莉莉在阿久津的床上醒来后,误以为自己在睡觉时被他给○○了,于是便挥刀砍向阿久津。

programme.title: 海贼王 #22
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.desc: 情遇上劫匪，但溢满发觉她竟身无分文！高家要众人自下月预缴家用。有义揭发有情为免高庆与妙喜入错货而吵架，老板娘要她自掏腰包购买，有义及溢满竟代有情辞职。高庆叫来老板娘来到高家摊牌，可是众人吓走了老板娘。

programme.desc: 买海鲜迎接丰足新一年！濑尿虾如何分雌雄，长颈、短颈濑尿虾又有甚么区别？「椒盐濑尿虾」要够惹味，切记鼎爷教落烹调贴士。他还豪购大量海鲜自制「海鲜汤泡饭」，原来龙虾壳及虾壳是汤底出味精髓！阿谭爱浅尝酒香，鼎爷善用酒酿与金华火腿的浓味，搭配桂花鱼蒸成佳肴。蒸一条硬身及厚身的鱼，有何方法更「吸火力」？一顿盛宴必有甜品作结，鼎爷不煮酒酿丸子，再升级煮出「酒酿鹌鹑蛋」糖水，做到一口吃下所有材料，满足感爆灯！

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 肌肉会随年纪流失，连同营养不良、缺乏运动等因素，不少长者都容易患上「肌少症」，容易跌倒，也间接减低了抵抗力与心肺功能。老人科专科医生指出，可透过日常生活困难、体重变更，大约知道此症状况，再透过适当运动来改善。小脑亦会中风，若不幸发生会影响平衡力与肌肉协调性，物理治疗师提出可借着小脑强化运动而增加相关能力，并即场示范多个训练动作。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie选用梅头肉，奉上惹味菜式「牛油蒜蓉里脊」。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2768粤
programme.desc: 出于某些理由，树仁得到一条名为「吃不了」的大鱼。大鱼要整条清蒸，树根打算借用Cafe的厨房烹调，敢佳要求一同享用，Andy等人亦要求参与。敢威有意一尝「吃不了」的滋味，力莲就「分配事宜」拟订「妥善」安排，并要求将鱼宴延后七天举行。熊家众人为照顾「吃不了」而疲于奔命，期间意外发现该鱼的秘密！力莲大事宣扬举办鱼宴，并计划进行直播，更邀请国际食评家来品鉴。事情越闹越大，树仁决定孤注一掷……

programme.title: X Wallet呈献:卧底娇娃#20粤PG
programme.desc: 索帕查出小茹是警察。奕风向喝醉的朱皮坦言关于女友之事，怎料朱皮却告诉妙姿。妙姿始知一直被奕风欺骗，往找佳琪和小茹评理，佳琪却叫她不要轻举妄动。丽荃突然被邦妮解雇，找刘彪诉苦。丽荃找佳琪帮忙偷偷拿回被邦妮收走的公司手机，小茹发现该手机竟与一个泰国号码互动密切，佳琪留意到奕风对这个号码似有所隐瞒。围捕在即，小茹担心索帕，毒品调查科捉到刘彪、察猜等人。小茹收到索帕相约见面的讯息，宗南派人暗中跟随……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈献：机智女法医2#12粤普
programme.desc: 谢怀定在出征前吃了一个小孩给的果子，中毒身亡。皇上下旨让森垚回府治病，森垚偷偷出门找鬼差求药，景翊尾随其后抓住了鬼差，此人竟跟周翰长得一模一样。瑾瑜命冷月从采石场带回周翰，并让周翰假扮鬼差，引出同党…

康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#28粤
programme.desc: 少龙见秦王口唇及指甲发黑，知他中了慢性毒药，明白是不韦所为。不韦在病危的秦王面前拥著朱姬，秦王被激死。嬴政终成为秦王，少龙拿著通讯器到山头，通讯器却没电。少龙催促滕翼等翻阅《鲁公秘录》，寻与电或稀硫酸有关的记载却不果。不韦拟好调配百官的名单，擢升自己人，嬴政没趣。琴清与邹衍对少龙说的生电原理全不理解，少龙泄气。不韦逼嬴政封他为「仲父」，嬴政感委屈。琴清看见闪电劈断大树，想到用闪电取电源，少龙兴奋。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统理发店买少见少，黄建东与黄耀英「帮衬」逾五十年历史的「飞发舖」，顺道观摩铁风筒、理发椅等店内生财工具，并畅谈「剃头佬教仔」等歇后语。各式食肆近年纷纷落户筲箕湾，这个「揾食热点」昔日曾被称为「饿人湾」，有何原因？衣著潮流讲求「花臣」，吴幸美实地了解洗水牛仔裤的加工过程，竟被取笑「阿婆揄裤」！广东话保留不少中国昔日用语，「睇」、「旧时」、「隔离」等在古代诗词已曾出现，大学中文讲师廖舜禧逐一讲解。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 广东人称钱包为「荷包」，「肇庆荷包」却是骂人的歇后语？手袋设计师把传统华丽的旧裙褂，改造成时款手袋，创意可谓「帽子烂了边－ 顶好」！嘉宾张惠雅还与主持们「扮鬼扮马」，了解造花牌这门逐渐失传的巧手工艺。「入得厨房，出得厅堂」向来是贤淑女生的形容词，上世纪四十、五十年代，一碗鱼蛋粉竟是理想「人妻」指标？「缩沙」、「淆底」跟《易经》又有甚么关连？历史专家郑宝鸿与大学中文讲师廖舜禧逐一拆解。

programme.desc: 阿曼弯刀, 一种阿曼传统表演-阿尔拉兹法的重要配饰 弯刀是阿曼珍贵的文化遗产, 象征住阿曼的历史和身份, 甚至于国家徽章都能看到其踪影 本集将介绍阿曼弯刀的制作过程及传统意义

programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 停泊岛海水清澈，为海洋生物提供优美的生长环境。三位美女与杨明大玩浮潜，欣赏七彩缤纷的海底世界，倍觉身心舒畅。夜幕低垂，四人坐在沙滩旁把酒谈心，凯琳回想大学时期曾受情绪问题困扰；高Ling亦诉说入行初期因负面新闻陷入困局。杨明忆起伤心往事，更不禁流下男儿泪！翌日天朗气清，又是时候玩游戏。四人畅玩独木舟后，挑战真心话大冒险。敏之大方公开性幻想对象，高Ling更当众「濑敏之鞋底」！杨明又何以满面奶油？

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅迁就山系新手颖彤，拣选从山顶广场出发的贴地郊游路线，轻松满足行山欲望。登上西高山顶观赏港岛南区，以及西九龙一带的「豪宅」景色，大地在我脚下！嘉宾杨潮凯带淑雅到上环元创方，穿梭艺术基地，最适合拍摄文青风唯美照片。祖仪、淑雅闺密宅度假，吃吃高空Tea、浸浸啤酒Spa，还结伴学习调酒，有姊妹像个宝！颖彤、祖仪随导游开展经典电影朝圣团，游走重庆大厦、广东道以至半岛酒店，探索多出影片取景之地。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 高比．拜仁是传奇篮球明星，却于2020年因直升机意外离世，众谷主希望透过这集，述说这位伟大球员的一生。高比高中毕业后便毅然辍学投身NBA，新秀赛季虽遭遇挫败，他却以疯狂训练迎难而上。凯文细述高比在赛场上的辉煌成就，以及如何克服伤患、坚持不懈训练，还提到他退役时撰写的「致篮球告白信」。高比的人生故事深深触动三位谷主，启发滢仴要活在当下，并反思自己加入演艺事业的初心；汛文也从中体会到定立目标的重要。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 一路前行粤普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中国生态保护，绿色高品质发展的环保公益纪实节目。透过沉浸式观察新时代环保议题，并邀请胡歌、刘涛、陈龙三位明星亲身参与，共同完成一场绿色低碳生活的行动。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 香港近年成为全球最长寿地区，几位十岁出头的孩子又希望活到多少岁？在节目组和洪永城安排下，小朋友分成两组，第一组到学校，向校长及负责老师了解校内如何推行生死教育，并共同饲养一条「宠物鱼」。第二组前往山野接受求生技巧训练，掌握搭建帐篷后，一试野外捉鱼并随即动刀㓥鱼。活动尾声，两组人都有一条鱼作「食物报酬」，为何一边感到雀跃，另一边却愁云惨雾？养鱼组别当知道眼前蒸鱼并非所养的宠物鱼，心情和胃口大为转变！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 伊奈的帐户再次被登入，太晴跟高轮与阿贺野分享伊奈的往事。H5的驾驶员觅得人选，对方叫五棱郭紫苑，由于人在函馆，故透过元宇宙与大家见面。紫苑透露有关恋爱的烦恼，舞与比娜听见后大为雀跃。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 三位小朋友来到「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，首先随教练Yama姐姐进行臀部训练。动作大多需要持续来做，考验肌耐力。有小朋友左右跳时感到疲累，想停下来，但于教练鼓励下仍坚持完成，精神值得嘉许。稍后的腿部强化训练，只需侧躺伸腿即可，较简单却有效，大家表现如何？「动物好萌友」环节有唐狗「琑琑」登场，牠会引领观众外出散步，并与朋友仔嬉玩，展现活泼可爱的一面。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子连续两天被人问路，原本以为是巧合，但长山同学对此事有不同的见解。小丸子与家人分吃蛋糕之后，因为觉得意犹未尽，于是说想试一次，独自吃全个完整的蛋糕，却遭到家人泼冷水。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视粤
programme.desc: 本台发现多区都有针对内地来港学生的中学生宿舍，一个床位月租高达16,000元，需求有多大？有二房东租下单位，改装学生宿舍出租，一个月收租高达12万，但原来不用申领牌照，法例是否存有灰色地带？随著来港读书的内地学生增加，中学生宿舍需求上升，本港如何检视相关配套？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 渣打优先私人理财呈献：Grand住享乐人生粤
programme.desc: 堪舆学家苏民峰藉旅游增广见闻，从穷游玩到每个月度假，实行边学边玩享乐人生！苏师傅还细谈北极格陵兰、法国滑雪奢华旅程点滴。西式食材结合中式烹饪手法，名厨李文星将中菜厅带到世界舞台，并亲自巡视多地分店，对品质有坚持！闯进超跑收藏家基地，一探其投资心得，高Ling还获邀坐上超跑游车河，感受车迷狂热。「世一」酒吧开业三年就登顶，有何成功之道？高Ling约同陈晓华酒聚交流，各自分享利物浦之行、超级游艇体验。

programme.title: 博爱欢乐传万家粤
programme.desc: 梁汉文以<舰队、<七友打头阵，为筹款晚会拉开序幕。钟镇涛带来<诚恳与<让我坦荡荡、车婉婉诉说<迟来的加冕、林晓培演绎<心动，乐迷期待。多个音乐单位的联动亦受注目，如周国贤与乐队ToNick的摇滚组合，钟舒漫率「声秀」学员的女团舞曲。还有胡鸿钧伙戴祖仪、冯熙燮跟邓小巧的男女合唱、冼靖峰与胡子贝的男男对唱、黄妍偕柯雨霏的女生版献声。太极乐队压轴登场，带来<红色跑车、<留住我吧等曲目。

programme.title: 伯乐音乐学院20周年呈献：J Music粤
programme.desc: 这集为《J Music》浓缩版，会倒数本星期「劲歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置，并相约马来西亚歌手卢信宥(Ash)畅谈音乐。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 学界足球精英赛决赛，拔萃男书院以2比1挫圣若瑟书院，缔造三连霸！甲一篮球总决赛第四场，香港东方力求再下一城封王，满贯又能否绝地反击扳平战局？艺人林慧倩细谈情迷MMA的缘由，并希望推动更多女生参与这项搏击运动。定向挑战赛设不同线上线下任务，这集一探中学生队伍的参赛感受。各界集结爱心跑，同心推广运动乐趣。优秀运动员计划向残特奥会得奖港将颁发奖金；另送上三铁亚锦赛战报，以及场地单车世界杯香港站记招花絮。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 近期全城掀起下载AI代理的热潮，市面的高阶电脑和配件也变得热卖，情况如何？去年香港新股市场集资额，重夺全球首位，今年的形势会如何？

programme.title: 叠影狙击#9粤PG
programme.desc: 晟杰根据线人的情报，让飞飞联络教授的中间人；因为晓晨的出现，霆钊到新加坡，向黑帮买凶杀晓晨；梁伯致电晓晨，说谋财害命的人来到安老院，晓晨立即赶到，遇见曾经跟梁曦有过节的Coco，晓晨怀疑她与梁曦的死有关…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅迁就山系新手颖彤，拣选从山顶广场出发的贴地郊游路线，轻松满足行山欲望。登上西高山顶观赏港岛南区，以及西九龙一带的「豪宅」景色，大地在我脚下！嘉宾杨潮凯带淑雅到上环元创方，穿梭艺术基地，最适合拍摄文青风唯美照片。祖仪、淑雅闺密宅度假，吃吃高空Tea、浸浸啤酒Spa，还结伴学习调酒，有姊妹像个宝！颖彤、祖仪随导游开展经典电影朝圣团，游走重庆大厦、广东道以至半岛酒店，探索多出影片取景之地。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 高比．拜仁是传奇篮球明星，却于2020年因直升机意外离世，众谷主希望透过这集，述说这位伟大球员的一生。高比高中毕业后便毅然辍学投身NBA，新秀赛季虽遭遇挫败，他却以疯狂训练迎难而上。凯文细述高比在赛场上的辉煌成就，以及如何克服伤患、坚持不懈训练，还提到他退役时撰写的「致篮球告白信」。高比的人生故事深深触动三位谷主，启发滢仴要活在当下，并反思自己加入演艺事业的初心；汛文也从中体会到定立目标的重要。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 停泊岛海水清澈，为海洋生物提供优美的生长环境。三位美女与杨明大玩浮潜，欣赏七彩缤纷的海底世界，倍觉身心舒畅。夜幕低垂，四人坐在沙滩旁把酒谈心，凯琳回想大学时期曾受情绪问题困扰；高Ling亦诉说入行初期因负面新闻陷入困局。杨明忆起伤心往事，更不禁流下男儿泪！翌日天朗气清，又是时候玩游戏。四人畅玩独木舟后，挑战真心话大冒险。敏之大方公开性幻想对象，高Ling更当众「濑敏之鞋底」！杨明又何以满面奶油？

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 节目组让小朋友写两封信，一封是给或将诞生的弟妹，另一封是自己的遗书。众人都抱着愉快心情迎接新生命，对离世之事伤感。百日宴和丧礼，是生与死的两桩人生大事，在筹办过程中却有不少相似的地方；洪永城带孩子们作进一步认识。有男生亲自体验躺棺木、遗体化妆，感受如何？及后他为参加百日宴变妆，妆容会有甚么不同？再探索二者的场地布置，小朋友对选择棺木、陪葬品各有想法；也会尝试为百日宴制作气球桥，及为丧礼预备棺面花。

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 阿曼弯刀, 一种阿曼传统表演-阿尔拉兹法的重要配饰 弯刀是阿曼珍贵的文化遗产, 象征住阿曼的历史和身份, 甚至于国家徽章都能看到其踪影 本集将介绍阿曼弯刀的制作过程及传统意义

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 传统理发店买少见少，黄建东与黄耀英「帮衬」逾五十年历史的「飞发舖」，顺道观摩铁风筒、理发椅等店内生财工具，并畅谈「剃头佬教仔」等歇后语。各式食肆近年纷纷落户筲箕湾，这个「揾食热点」昔日曾被称为「饿人湾」，有何原因？衣著潮流讲求「花臣」，吴幸美实地了解洗水牛仔裤的加工过程，竟被取笑「阿婆揄裤」！广东话保留不少中国昔日用语，「睇」、「旧时」、「隔离」等在古代诗词已曾出现，大学中文讲师廖舜禧逐一讲解。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 广东人称钱包为「荷包」，「肇庆荷包」却是骂人的歇后语？手袋设计师把传统华丽的旧裙褂，改造成时款手袋，创意可谓「帽子烂了边－ 顶好」！嘉宾张惠雅还与主持们「扮鬼扮马」，了解造花牌这门逐渐失传的巧手工艺。「入得厨房，出得厅堂」向来是贤淑女生的形容词，上世纪四十、五十年代，一碗鱼蛋粉竟是理想「人妻」指标？「缩沙」、「淆底」跟《易经》又有甚么关连？历史专家郑宝鸿与大学中文讲师廖舜禧逐一拆解。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 以畏高见称的何浩文，竟与黄美棋来一场攀石争队员！吴若希、吴嘉熙首次参与，表现如何？纸巾攻防战，有人保护纸巾时仍可摆诱人姿势，亦有人母性大发，竟与对手谈判议和！篮球场上的攻防战，用上人肉篮球架，料不及会演变成一场综合格斗，场面一片混乱。讲到掷忌廉，场面更难控制！杨潮凯施展最贱本性，美棋无惧高度问题向陈嘉桓连番攻击，有甚么事发生令监制忍不住要出声？两队以三人两手形式的乒乓球赛分胜负，输家败在杀球太多。

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 众人的实习来到尾声，最后一次实习课题的内容是再次参与野培工作，他们分成两组，一组要到野外监测和安全巡查，另一组则留在工作站；到了最后一天的上班日，大家怀著依依不舍的心情去打扫圈舍和喂饲大熊猫。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 钻石时装大赛盛大落幕一刻，黛雅突然异变，闪亮宿上空出现了巨大的黑色能量块，全世界的星梦频道更加停止了。艾菈和杏树猜测黛雅是这件事的主因，未来跟大家拼命地想找出解决方法，但是……

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 氢气球从杜拜出发，计划环游世界，大雄跟胖虎与小夫打赌，倘若旅程失败便要挨打一百记拳头。大雄打出全垒打，却把小夫新买的棒球打进水里，为了筹钱赔偿，大雄把快乐回忆抵押给「记忆贷款」。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: 音济因拍摄电视台重头剧而感到充实，更获邀参演由知名小说改编的舞台剧，讵料经理人公司却以时间重叠为由擅自推掉，令音济大受打击，其后更离家出走，是国率先在公园找到他，尝试开解对方。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 糖妹、娅溦变身优雅吃货，置身以老香港美学打造的点心餐厅，品尝炖老鸽汤、波龙芦笋饺、Q弹太雕蛋蒸黄鱼，黑米咸水角又有甚么惊喜滋味？两位可人儿转往别致Cafe，一件拿破仑草莓蛋糕，她们竟掀起吉士酱与奶油之争！分途发掘魔都小店，糖妹踏足潮人必到的中古风生活杂货，搜罗各式可爱造型的创意家品。另一边厢，娅溦在澳洲网红旗舰店朝圣，「悉瓜」蛋糕一试难忘。放慢脚步，二人偷得浮生光顾酒馆，糖妹还会挑战辣辣上海川菜！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 健康一族推崇茹素，肥妈和6号深入有机农场采摘特色蔬菜，准备一顿「素食宴」。他们还即摘即吃三色堇、金莲花，口感有多独特？阿6捧来寓意「一本万利」的尖形椰菜花，让阿妈炮制出口感延绵的浓汤。「南瓜牛蒡燕麦饭」既高纤又高钙，每一啖尝尽多重甜味！不过，燕麦与白米的份量比例如何？肥妈接着用椰菜制作「两食」。将素猪肉酿入椰菜后蒸煮，是甚么新派菜式？另一道以椰菜碎、甘笋等做成的「紫椒素菜饼」，更是色香味兼备！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 宜于清凉天气生长的西洋菜具有防癌功效，肥妈在春天离开前把握时机，炮制时令菜式「椒丝腐乳炒西洋菜」，并分享「一菜二用」心得。靓汤「竹蔗茅根煲海底椰无花果」，清热润肺而且滋阴解渴，四季皆宜。阿妈落足心机主理「越南鱼露煎猪扒」，酱汁以鱼露、辣椒等调制而成，创新风味非一般香浓，岂止「猪有猪味」！而要令猪扒肉质松软，下锅前切记刺孔及拍松。另一道菜式「咸蛋蒸节瓜」，将上汤注入咸蛋、节瓜再蒸，即成经典家常滋味。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 亲近动物有不少方法，这趟旅程会多角度展示。从小已怕动物的慰玲猜拳输了要喂羊驼，竟被牠吓至跌倒，还惊到喊。朱仔首次骑马后，形容似「坐过山车」，一边骑马，一边亦可欣赏户外骏域谷的美景。主持们还乘坐马车游览，振朗却差点被抛出车外。深入远离悉尼市区的猎人谷，先到百年历史的酒窖品酒，加上朱古力Pairing就更出众？其后，三位好友安躺草地看日落，细谈「浪漫的定义」。而慰玲心目中的浪漫，竟只是一句话这般简单？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 继续畅游猎人谷，主持们在户外学造朱古力；朱仔尝试追女仔惨「食柠檬」，只好向男拍档出手？玩电动平衡车时，振朗被慰玲「嫌废」。在邦迪海滩开心踏浪，怎料众人最终湿身收场！清晨五时，大家划独木舟出海看日出。「咸蛋黄」初升之际，画面却令幕后人员崩溃，究竟发生何事？振朗及后更模仿蔡思贝发声控诉？在酒吧喝着鸡尾酒聚话，节目组准备了情感问题，让三人来一趟深情对话。当要向身旁好友说出心底话，振朗、慰玲更双双落泪……

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 不少人都会趁著母亲节，使出尘封多年的厨艺，藉著爱心美食回馈母亲养育之恩。从未做过甜品的王卓淇要为母亲献出她的第一次，向甜品达人古嘉俊(阿古)学做「红莓苹果牛奶朱古力挞」，透过爱心造型及香甜口味，让王妈妈甜在心头。青苹果与软心朱古力味道互相配合，中和甜腻感觉，保留青苹果皮还有助增加甜品松脆口感。卓淇在节目中尽显精灵活泼个性，令学习过程充满欢乐气氛，期间一条有关青苹果的问题，却何以令阿古啼笑皆非？

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 太晴一行人去到函馆跟紫苑见面，谁知对方竟然是女孩子。紫苑讲解事情的来龙去脉后，请求茜代她出面去见由纪。由纪知道真相后逃去，敌人却在此时突然出现，为了去找由纪，紫苑一心尽快打倒敌人。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 音乐是一种无国界的艺术，即使不懂拉丁文，只要用心感受与多加练习，亦可美妙地演唱出来。有合唱团带来一首拉丁歌曲，以歌声说明个中道理。不少演出者均会穿起美丽衣服，化上精致妆容，展现别出心裁的动作与舞步。这次登上「My Little Show」舞台的五位小舞者，又为大家带来甚么感觉？另外，结他导师伙拍玲玲姐姐、彤彤姐姐，借着颂唱<身体健康和<单车发放温暖，向关心自己的家人诉说感谢语句与祝福。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 马尔济斯要求尖耳用一个月时间造出机械警官，尖耳尽力而为但失败，情急之下穿上机械人外壳假扮汪汪机械人。茄士咩店舖外的人偶被车撞毁，卷发提议让汪汪机械人与屁屁侦探比赛谁先找出犯人。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子抽不到想要的百惠襟章，觉得自己运气不佳，于是想尽率法招福，例如喝福茶和玩福笑面。小丸子打算穿一件旧毛衣去溜冰，但上面起满毛球，跟妈妈学会如何剪毛球后，小丸子竟然沉迷进去。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤

programme.desc: 香港曾经受过战火洗礼，不论是陆地或海底，留下不少战时炸弹，而在六七暴动期间，街头上出现不少土制炸弹，需要动员拆除，后来警队在1972年成立爆炸品处理科，专门处理爆炸品。有人因爆炸而终生受影响，有人愿意站于前线为市民拆除危机，在爆裂时刻他们会如何面对？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤

programme.title: 东张西望粤

programme.title: 香港何济公止痛退热散呈献：中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 比赛新一轮揭开「黑白荣耀」篇章，三十强参赛者以钢琴的黑白琴键为概念，根据往绩排名，分成「上弦黑队」与「下弦白队」，启动一对一PK激斗。上弦选手按分数高低自由选择登场次序，而下弦选手则抽签决定对战位置。黑白荣耀换位赛将分三集举行，每集上演五局对决。对战分数较高的选手可稳坐「荣耀宝座」，较低分者会跌入「危险区」，而每集的危险区将有2人被淘汰。

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 方力申廿五年前从泳坛转战乐坛，曾被网民看扁「无法出头」，至今却仍立足乐坛还成功入纸获批举行红馆个唱。如果重新选择，当年可会再拣做歌手？翻查过往片段，方爸爸原来极为着紧小方的游泳成绩；刚为人父的小方，又可会栽培女儿接班？小方坦言结婚、生育让其变成熟，究竟是怎样认识太太，并认定她是终身伴侣？主持区永权邀请小方即席献声，唱毕即有神秘嘉宾现身！但两位嘉宾似是爆料多于撑场，其中一人更称小方曾多次「偷食」……

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 行仔与鼎爷走访开设于历史建筑内的中菜馆，品尝清蒸东星斑、无花果黑豚咕噜肉，鼎爷更细说相关「尝识」。黄嘉雯驾车载胡美贻到九龙城觅食，享用居酒屋招牌半熟海龙烧，海胆与龙虾肉完美结合；龙虾还可两吃，虾头可熬汤或煮粥。另有热石黑蒜拉面，以热石保温，极具特色！观塘有食店推出只售28元的外卖焗猪扒意粉，「抵食」指数「爆灯」！伍倩彤搜罗湾仔特色街头美食，遍尝秘制奶茶配芫荽三色蛋三文治、海盐黑松露松饼，充满惊喜！

programme.desc: 振朗三人跟澳洲名胜三姐妹峰打卡，某人合照时笑言其美貌无死角！路旁驶来红色跑车，只有两名幸运儿可自驾游车河，对讲机的另一端则不断传来被抛下那一位的「葡萄」话语。众主持于下午茶时间聊天，话题竟是围绕内裤「乱噏」！到达豪华住宿地，朱仔躺进浴缸中不愿起来。振朗随后躺在其身上，还哼起歌来，果真有福同享？入夜，大家把酒谈心。三人于剧集《反黑路人甲》建立友谊，谈及这剧的拍摄点滴，振朗有一幕忍笑失败仍被播出？

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地气的外景行脚节目,由名人带领网路红人到店家体验吃、喝、玩、乐。寓教于乐，带给观众耳目一新的超强体验。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 少年时代
programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 少年时代
programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: Kidaverse Roblox Rumble - Kidaverse Roblox Rumble Ep11 - EP11

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Da Vinci: From Head to Toe
programme.desc: From the day their eyes open, babies begin to observe new things around the world and about themselves. Baby Da Vinci™ From Head to Toe presents them with a playful and interactive introduction to the human body in three languages -- English, Spanish, and French. With a whimsical blend of adorable puppets, real children and animals and famous works of art, this captivating program also features upbeat classical music.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Peace and Harmony - EP108
programme.desc: In this episode of Kids' Planet, we will make a trip to discover what two important words mean: "Peace" and "Harmony". Our friend Curious who knows everything will guide us through the universe of values, teaching us a very important quality in "Kindness", and we will learn to reject violence, manage anger, make good decisions, and have self-control.

programme.title: Mellodees - London Bridge Is Falling Down - EP6
programme.desc: Playtime gets interrupted when Dee's four-legged friend, Treble knocks down his creation. No need to get upset though, Dee and Treble rebuild the bridge while smiling and laughing together. A great display of teamwork.

programme.title: Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy - Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy Ep15 - EP115
programme.desc: In a new spin-off series of mini-episodes - ‘Sunny Bunnies Get Busy’ - the characters are on hand to entertain and engage viewers in various colourful and creative activities and inspire children to 'Get Busy'.

programme.title: Giselle and the Green Team - The Case of the Missing Marsh - EP107
programme.desc: Gisele and her Green Team fight Nick Slick from draining and destroying a marsh to build a palm oil plantation.

programme.title: Rainbow Rangers S2 - Wid, Wild Horses Safari Away From Me - EP225
programme.desc: Preston's latest get-rich-quick scheme to sell wild mustangs goes awry; a man causes a baby elephant to become separated from her mother.

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Burpin’ Babies Backpack Payback - EP118
programme.desc: Kent’s youth serum works a little too well and turns the gang into screaming babies. The serum soon wears off – sort of – now they’re adults trapped in baby bodies and Von Bolt doesn’t know whether to obey or burp them. When the Anti-Matters steal JD's backpack and discover the portable ALVA, they unwittingly cause Edison's hologram to disappear. The Secret Lab Kids must concoct a plan to retrieve the backpack before Edison's lost forever.

programme.title: Secret Millionaires Club - Camp Big Foot - EP126
programme.desc: At Camp Big Foot, the SMC Kids and TWIN COUNSELORS search for BIG FOOT to raise money for the camp, only to get trapped on an island with two counselors that won't stop squabbling and what about Big Foot?!

Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s "a-go-go" era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family...

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's "The Book and the Sword". A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu".

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng's friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events...

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and has to team up with his partner to recover the munitions so as to prevent a disaster from occurring.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Lifeline

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II

At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm's VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - She Who Walks In The Shadows
programme.desc: When Jim discovers Claire’s sickness is much different than an average cold, they must traverse into the dangerous Shadow Realm to save her life.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Parental Guidance
programme.desc: The Trollhunters are paused from action when their parents stage an intervention to get answers from the kids.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Monstrous Mayhem of the Massive Melviathan
programme.desc: A run-of-the-mill arts and crafts session turns into an interdimensional adventure from which Harold, George and company may never return.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Savage Spite of the Slimy Salamangler
programme.desc: Krupp's campers take on rich rivals in a hoity-toity boat race that also features a revenge-obsessed giant salamander. Paging Captain Underpants!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Cunning Combat of the Covert Camoflush
programme.desc: The campers' splat-tastic game of paintball is rather rudely interrupted by a foul and formidable fiend known only as Camoflush.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - North of the Border
programme.desc: With his identity as a fugitive businessman exposed, Boss Baby has been hiding out in the lawless land of Canada. But he’s forced back into action over a new crisis with Baby Love: several criminals have copycatted Boss’s fugitive strategy, somehow turning themselves into babies to hide out from the law. While Tina works on exposing these new fake baby criminals to the world, Boss makes a dangerous journey across Canada to sneak back over the U.S. border.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Intensive Purposes
programme.desc: After getting caught at the border, Boss, Tim, JJ, and Pip have to organize an escape from a "former novelty restaurant turned interrogation facility" using only the four phone calls they’ve been given. Meanwhile, Tina has a plan for Dez to infiltrate the criminal baby organization to break them up from the inside, but it’s complicated when Tina’s new assistant Temp Baby Aubrey accidentally takes over Dez’s undercover baby criminal role.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: Team Voltron uses the Black Lion to lure Zarkon into battle

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Blackout
programme.desc: The team executes their final plan to cripple Zarkon once and for all

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Price Of Freedom
programme.desc: Grayson wrangles Spirit "fair and square" and sends him to auction in another town --and there is nothing Lucky can do to stop him!

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bees Sting
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bees didn't sting. All the animals loved the Bees and they especially loved their sweet and yummy honey. The trouble was all the precious honey was disappearing and there was a honey crisis in Tinga Tinga. Something had to be done. Luckily clever old Tortoise has a cunning plan. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Peacock Struts
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Peacock didn't strut. He was a very proud bird and he wanted to be the best at everything. He wanted to be the best bird-brain in Tinga Tinga. He wanted to be the best flyer in Tinga Tinga and he wanted to have the biggest and the best tail in Tinga Tinga…. But as Lion so wisely points out ‘Sometimes it's not good to get everything you want!' Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Car Boot Sale
programme.desc: Big Chris has a clear out and takes all his old junk up to Farmer Green's car boot sale but misses the clutter in Rusty. How will he get everything back?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hot Stuff
programme.desc: Big Chris takes the cars to the beach to relax in the heat but he is so busy dealing with the cars he forgets to drink his water. But hang on, who else has drunk it…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Law And Order
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is fed up with the cars running amok on his track and summons Bill and Nick to restore order to the track. But might our overzealous policeman overstep the mark?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash's Tea Party

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - FB's Sleepover
